about_the_game:
Ayano and Takumi are childhood friends, and spend all the time they're not busy pining for each other. It's a classic story of unrequited love... until it's not! In a twist of fate, they actually manage to confess their feelings to one another, and they couldn't be happier for it.

Unfortunately, there are countless hurdles in the way of their true love, especially when both Ayano and Takumi are high-profile individuals... They make a pact to keep it a secret from everyone—even friends and family. It's the safest way to approach the matter and avoid all sorts of problems down the line.

Alas, somebody seems to have found out anyway, and the rumors begin spreading... Who's behind it all? And how will these secret schemers threaten their perfect and pure happiness? Find out in this heart-throbbing tale of love and mystery!

Live through the story of Ayano and Takumi in this wild text-based adventure game. Who's trying to break our lovely couple apart? What's their aim? There is love, there is mystery, and so much more in Everybody Wants My Girl!

Deception and Subterfuges:

There's clearly a mastermind at work here, but who are they, and what's their aim? Unravel the mystery as you follow Ayano and Takumi try to keep their relationship secret and alive.

Branching Storylines:

Rather than telling a singular story, the game will branch into diverging timelines, and those antagonizing the relationship of our protagonists will change based on your choices. Pick your poison, if you will...

Gorgeous Character Art:

A cast of classic rom-com characters brings the story to life together with the beautiful, expressive art that their personalities shine!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 8/8.1/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 11/10/8
  • Processor: 2+ GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.

short_description: Ayano loves Takumi, and Takumi loves Ayano, a classic story of unrequited love... until it's not! They finally confess their love to each other, and they couldn't be happier for it. Unfortunately, relationships are not allowed. Can their love survive in secret?
